findings.title: Provider refund confirmation remains unverified
evidence: coder-report.md reports missing payment configuration and an unverified provider-to-app refund.
findings.expected_outcome: A dedicated synthetic sandbox commission completes the upheld-flag path, confirms the matching full refund, retains client file restrictions, and creates no release.
findings.assessment: Local synthetic evidence supports the implementation, but does not establish provider integration success. This is not a demonstrated application defect.

findings.title: Race and interruption coverage falls short of the designed cases
evidence: final/tests/deliveries.test.ts.snapshot:373 establishes a hold before invoking scheduled expiry; it does not race those operations.
The competing-transition tests do not explicitly establish both commit orders.
The refund test exercises refusal and lost responses, but does not interrupt processing between claim and finish.
findings.expected_outcome: Both transition orders preserve one version-bound outcome. An interrupted refund run remains pending and a subsequent retry reconciles the same charge before requesting another refund.
findings.assessment: Static guards support these outcomes, but the supplied execution evidence does not demonstrate all of them.

static_inspection.refunds: Confirmation requires a canonical matching sandbox charge and REFUNDED status. Pending intent persists across failed processing, with reviewer retry available.
static_inspection.role_separation: Reviewer identity is configured by auth user ID. Participant conflicts are checked for decisions and reviewer evidence access.
static_inspection.version_holds: Flags bind the funded current version. Disputed state blocks revisions, submissions, manual approval and scheduled release.
static_inspection.settlement_exclusivity: The ruling and state transition share a mutation. Subsequent conflicting decisions are rejected.
static_inspection.factual_reputation: Counts derive from distinct funded offers and current commission records. Refunded payments retain originally-paid counts; revisions and versions do not multiply commissions.

supplied_executed_evidence.suite: Logs report 2 Node tests and 66 Vitest tests passed.
supplied_executed_evidence.browser: Two stub-backed scenarios report passing at desktop and narrow widths.
supplied_executed_evidence.checks: Supplied typecheck and optimized-build logs report success.

limitations: Only restricted packet files were accessed.
No application tests were executed during this assessment; execution claims above come from supplied artifacts.
Snapshots are not a complete runnable checkout.
No account, network, collaboration, external resource or link access was used.
No exploits or bypass attempts were designed or performed.
